message.body:
Dear colleagues at Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH,

Thank you for your message.

Our forecast for Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc rises 6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).
Our orders of Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2025-05-26 (po:4500012506-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013479-10) and EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-09-30 (po:4500014475-10): the price has been unchanged.
Our orders of Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-20), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2025-06-02 (po:4500012538-10), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-01-30 (po:4500013504-10) and EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-10): the price has been unchanged.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.86; payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.91; payment 90 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.88; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 36 months.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
message.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge your forecast and the proposed binding volume of 30,000 units per year over a 36-month period. 

We are willing to support your preferred terms of 45 days net payment and a 36-month contract duration. Reflecting these adjustments, we can offer a revised unit price of €5.54. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? 

Our current offer is a price of €5.56 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €5.54 per unit, which also features a price of €5.54 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
